checks.area: EQ-001 dangling extraction group after queue-item removal

evidence.detail: Active queued/extracting groups still block removal. Removing an item now removes every non-complete extraction group that references it, cleans its secret, and leaves other QueueItems/downloads intact; complete groups only lose the removed item ID.

The failed two-volume regression case asserts the other item remains complete, the extraction group is removed, the old secret is forgotten, and extraction is not started. The predicate also covers waiting groups; the focused test is for failed status.

Rows belonging to queued/extracting groups suppress the remove button. Removable linked rows use the localized accessible action text indicating extraction cancellation while keeping downloaded files.

checks.area: Watchdog alarm postponed by repeated QC_GET/UI progress reads

evidence.detail: The QC_GET path asks arm() to preserve an existing alarm scheduled within the next 30 seconds; it returns without clearing/replacing that watchdog alarm.
Two repeated UI reads leave the already scheduled watchdog deadline unchanged.

checks.area: Expired-password retry and ambiguous native job handling

evidence.detail: Native secret-expired/secret-not-found errors map to password_expired.

On password_expired, blank input is sent explicitly as password: "" so a fresh empty secret is stored for an unencrypted archive; ordinary blank input still omits the password and retains the existing secret.

Busy/capacity errors leave the operation pending; ambiguous state/conflict/internal errors keep the same operation ID and expose unknown_job instead of marking terminal failure. Retry-extraction accepts only status failed.
Native start checks an existing job record and request identity before reading the secret; an existing result/state is returned, while malformed state is rejected rather than treated as a new ID.
